evidence: purchase_units[0].payments.captures[0] COMPLETED with custom_id and invoice_id

not_passed.check: Buyer-side Transaction Search shows the co-signature hash
not_passed.why: Permission granted. Earlier in-app charges 7UE89006K1324024J and 4H098055JS548532U show in Transaction Search with the co-signature hash as custom_field and the invoice number. Our only REST app belongs to the supplier, so this is the supplier account's view (BUYER_ACTIVITY_SIDE=payee); a payer-owned app was not available. On the Nov 13 KST read-only recheck, charges 6ET89834W30050123 and 2J9177124Y098483N matched their visitors; 0XD347862X366022X raised an alert and paused only its own visitor when the three sandbox rows were passed to the audit with a memory copy of the recorded co-signatures.

not_passed.check: A payer with no funding source declines a charge above its balance
not_passed.why: The test payer had a linked bank and card, and PayPal funded the charge from them. The app makes no claim about this.
Needs a registered webhook and a public host. Tested on the mock only.
